preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The number of sets in each test case is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each set contains between 2 and 10^5 elements, inclusive.
Each element in a set is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All elements in each set are different.
The total number of elements in all sets in all test cases is not greater than 2⋅10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases is not greater than 2⋅10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is either -1 or two integers separated by a space.
postconditions.description: The output is either a pair of indices indicating similar sets or -1 if no such pair exists.

postconditions.expression: If output is not -1, then the two sets share at least two common elements.
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then the two sets have at least two elements in common.

postconditions.expression: If output is -1, then no two sets share at least two common elements.
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, then no two sets have at least two elements in common.
